Rohan: Quick heads-up — qbringup for q4b-int4 showed a pile of synthetic anchors that look like near-duplicates. They flooded the labeler queue. Can we throttle or dedupe before labeling?
Maya: Ugh. Did they bypass the fuzzyhash check?
Rohan: Looks like they were generated by the synth pipeline v2; metadata missing canonical fingerprint so fuzzyhash didn't catch them.
Sam: I can add a pre-label dedupe step, but we need a deterministic rule. Options:
- use tokenized fingerprint + ctxlen
- ngram sim > 0.95
- exact metadata id if present
Li: I'd prefer token-fingerprint + shortctx threshold. Short ctxs (<=64) are high false-positive risk, so we should also check unique anchor seeds.
Sam: Draft SQL I can run in the ingestion job:
```sql
WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT id, token_fp, ctx_len FROM synth_ingest WHERE created_at > now() - interval '3 days'
)
DELETE FROM synth_ingest s USING candidates c WHERE s.id <> c.id AND s.token_fp = c.token_fp AND abs(s.ctx_len - c.ctx_len) <= 8;
```
Maya: Let's not delete automatically — move duplicates to a quarantine table and surface to labelers. We still need a few representative variants for golden.
Rohan: Agreed. Also need to surface a golden injection plan: add 200 vetted anchors to golden set, stratify by model failure mode. Will coordinate with labeling.
Ana: I can reconfigure labeler queue thresholds: bump max_batch=40 and add per-labeler rate cap so one anchor type doesn't starve others.
Sam: I'll open a deploy PR for the dedupe job and add quarantine export. PR link: https://git/redwood/ingest/merge/456
labeler-bot: created ticket RL-987: "quarantine export for synth dedupe" assigned to Sam
Maya: thx. Can we schedule a short sync tomorrow 10am to sign off golden selection? @Rohan @Sam @Ana :thumbsup:
Rohan: Yup. Adding a mini checklist in the doc: https://docs.redwood/synth-dedupe-checklist
Ana: will add rate-limit defaults after sync. :+1:
Sam: running initial dry-run tonight, will post results here.
Maya: great — if dry-run looks clean we promote quarantine -> golden candidate list.
